document: ISO/IEC JTC1/SC29/WG1 M109040 — JPEG RF Exploration Study 5 (PCQ)
source_pdf: docs/PCQ-Report on Exploration Study 5 of JPEG RF.pdf
description: Test camera trajectories for subjective QA of radiance fields. Training poses are used to select key views, optional ghost views, then a centripetal Catmull–Rom spline with arc-length reparameterization and quaternion SLERP orientations.

fps_keys8.label: FPS baseline (garden Fig.2a)
fps_keys8.notes: Spatial coverage only (α=1). No ghosts. Fixed FPS/duration for subjective tests.

coverage_keys12.label: Coverage — 12 keys (garden Fig.2b)
coverage_keys12.notes: Balanced coverage + orientation; more keys for wide scenes.

coverage_orient_keys8.label: Orientation-diverse — 8 keys (garden Fig.2c)
coverage_orient_keys8.notes: Lower α stresses varied look directions over spatial spread.

ghost_gentle_orient.label: Ghost + gentle orientation (garden Fig.2d)
ghost_gentle_orient.notes: Recommended default for generalization testing without unstable extrapolation.

ghost_strong_span.label: Ghost + strong span / parallax (garden Fig.2f)
ghost_strong_span.notes: Long-baseline bridges; probes parallax and occlusions.

mellifont_recommended.label: MellifontAbbey — recommended subjective path
mellifont_recommended.notes: Same as ghost_gentle_orient; use with eva/_eval_100views/cameras_100.json as training poses.
